_schema.note: The six systems on the board. Order matters — it is the order they render in, left to right, and 'backups' sits last because losing it is the run's worst moment and should read as the far end of the board.

fields.id: slug. Scenario 'target' values must match one of these.
fields.name: shown on the map
fields.short: shown at 375px, where the full name will not fit
fields.loss: one line, present tense, describing what stops working when this system is lost. Color is never the only carrier of meaning — this is the text that carries it.

_schema.integrity: Each system holds 2 (operational), 1 (degraded) or 0 (lost). A breach on the targeted system takes it to 0. A mitigated stage degrades it by 1. Recovery brings the worst-off system back up by 1.
